source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Visually verify storage LED solid green when powered, blinking green during read/write and off when ready to remove.
procedure_facts: Requires three physical visual states over 60 attended and 60 machine minutes.
criteria_facts: Solid green powered; blinking green read/write; off ready-to-remove.
missing_source_information: Exact device/slot/LED lens and platform meaning, non-destructive activity method, safe-removal workflow, operator/camera and hot-plug SOP.

original_test_intent.statement: Physically observe the identified storage device's status/activity LED through powered-idle, active I/O and formally prepared-for-removal states and compare color/behavior with the platform specification.
must_preserve: All three states, physical visual evidence, exact slot/device and full 60-minute activity.
must_not_infer: That LED off itself proves data is flushed or physical removal is safe.
That write I/O to production data is authorized.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly retains operator-only visual judgment, adds slot identity/photos, safe power/I/O/removal states, no destructive command and log preservation.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 says the operator prepares removal but does not require an independent OS/controller safe-removal confirmation before using the off-state, leaving a risk that LED-off is treated as removal authorization.

related_records: Storage slot mapping and hot-plug cases cannot replace this visual LED behavior test.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Source-specific colors/states are preserved; platform SOP must establish readiness independently of the LED.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: A qualified operator must observe all three LED states. The agent may coordinate a bounded non-destructive activity and evidence, but the controller/OS/SOP—not LED-off—must establish removal readiness; no drive removal is required.

missing: Slot/LED map, exact color/blink specification, safe I/O target, prepare-to-remove procedure, hot-plug capability, operator/camera and approval.
provider: Lab owner/operator supplies physical access and safe transition/I/O plan.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory device persistent identity, slot/controller/filesystem/mount/RAID state, current LEDs via operator baseline and logs without activity or removal.
prohibited_until_resolved: Writes to unapproved data, unmount/offline/remove/power change, log clearing, inferring LED state or PASS remotely.
closure_evidence: Signed device-slot-LED map, non-destructive activity target, safe-removal SOP and qualified operator/evidence plan.

revision_candidate.purpose: Visually verify the exact storage slot's LED is solid green when powered and idle, blinks green during approved I/O, and turns off after the OS/controller has independently confirmed the device is ready for removal, without using the LED itself as safety authorization.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact chassis/backplane/controller/drive protocol and firmware whose LED behavior matches the signed platform specification; NVMe and SAS/SATA enclosure indicators may differ.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every owner-selected storage device/slot required by the recipe, with the same physical LED lens and persistent device identity followed through all three states. Allocate the source's full 60-minute attended/machine activity; actual drive removal is outside scope unless separately authorized.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Chassis/slot/LED map and signed color/blink/off meanings; drive serial/WWN/EUI and controller/OS mapping; approved read-only or scratch I/O fixture; filesystem/data protection; prepare-to-remove/offline/hot-plug SOP and capability; operator/camera, maintenance, recovery and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Record persistent device/slot/LED identity, baseline health/logs and powered-idle operator photo/video. Generate bounded approved I/O, preferring reads or an isolated scratch target, while the operator captures timestamped blinking green and the agent correlates activity. Stop I/O, flush/verify as required and execute only the approved OS/controller prepare-to-remove workflow without removing the drive. After independent readiness confirmation, the operator records the LED-off state. Restore the device to normal service and verify storage health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact mapping/spec; qualified operator; protected data; supported state transitions; approved I/O and removal-readiness workflow; OOB/recovery and evidence ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Chassis/controller/backplane/drive identity; slot/LED map; persistent serial/WWN/EUI; operator checklist and timestamped color-correct photo/video for solid, blink and off; exact I/O target/command/rate/times; OS/controller prepare-to-remove confirmation distinct from LED; device/log/health baseline/deltas; normal-service restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed platform LED specification and safe-removal SOP. Pass requires all three specified visual behaviors on the same mapped device/LED with matching system state, independent readiness confirmation before the off observation and healthy restoration; software telemetry alone is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not clear logs, write production data, infer slot by `/dev` order, touch/remove an active device, treat LED off as safety proof, claim visual observation remotely, force hot-plug, continue on filesystem/controller/error/heat anomaly or omit restoration.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Qualified operator performs visual/state observations; storage owner approves I/O and prepare-to-remove transition; engineer judges color/blink and discrepancies.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical vision is manual. Agent may collect identity/activity/logs and coordinate approved state transitions but cannot attest color/blink/off or touch hardware.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong LED/device, I/O/filesystem/controller error, unsafe power/heat or readiness failure, stop, do not remove, preserve evidence, return the device online through SOP and verify array/filesystem/host health before escalation.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: No unique device-slot-LED map; missing operator/spec/SOP/approval; data target unsafe; unsupported hot-plug/removal transition; unexpected LED/fault color; activity or readiness mismatch; storage/filesystem/controller error; incomplete visual evidence.

identified_defects: LED-off can be misused as removal-readiness proof.
I/O target/data safety and persistent slot identity are underspecified.
Remote Agent cannot attest physical color/blink.
reason_for_change: Preserve manual LED validation while separating visual behavior from the independent safe-removal decision and preventing destructive activity generation.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Storage-00070-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: Three required visual states and 60-minute values.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Platform LED meanings and safe-removal SOP are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Same device/LED tracked through all states.
Activity constrained to protected read/scratch method.
resolved_blockers: Hybrid coordination is possible, but visual acceptance remains MANUAL ONLY.
remaining_blockers: Operator, platform LED/removal spec, exact mapping and safe I/O plan required.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 adds a critical safety separation: the OS/controller must prove removal readiness before the LED-off observation, so a dark LED can never authorize handling the drive; it also retains one persistent device identity across all three states.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator preserved all three states on one persistent device/LED, the manual visual boundary and full 60-minute plan, preferred read/scratch I/O, required independent readiness before LED-off, prohibited removal and required restoration.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 435 requires solid green, blinking green and off LED states over 60 minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 makes visual work manual; V3 prevents LED-off from being removal authorization and binds persistent device identity.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Only inventory/baseline is safe until operator, mapping, I/O and removal SOP are approved.
